note: Lodge, cabins and RV park at about 8,300 ft in the Bighorns on US-14A near Burgess Junction, with a restaurant and bar and snowmobile/side-by-side rentals; the RV sites sit in the trees west of the lodge. In winter US-14A is closed west toward Cody, and the only way in is US-14. --Claude
summary: Operator site live: 30-amp RV park, full hookup from $47, water/electric from $37 (under $50, no gate issue), bookable on ResNexus or by phone. Google 4.3 (438). RV Life $. Not long-stay. Pin on the lodge, RV sites within ~150 m; no move. Not waterfront stands. Stored year_round is the resort's, not shown for the RV park - flag. Phone empty -> 307-752-2444.
flags: PRICE: posted 'Rates starting at' $37 (water/electric) and $47 (full hookup); under US$50, no exception needed. 'Starting at' means peak nights could run higher; the ResNexus quote was not opened (resnexus.com refuses bots).
PRESENCE: website + phone 307-752-2444; Google 4.3 from 438 reviews (shared with the lodge/restaurant). RV Life price tier $ (stored).
LONG-STAY: nothing on the pages suggests monthly or seasonal residents; a transient lodge RV park.

SEASON: stored year_round (derived from the old note) rests on 'We're open year-round', which is the lodge's; the pages never say the RV park stays open through 225-250 in. of winter snow at 8,300 ft. Left alone (pages silent on the RV park's season) - reviewer may clear it.
OHV: a snowmobile/side-by-side rental base with trails from the door, but a general lodge and RV park, not an OHV staging campground; flag only.
WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' stands: a small pond lies ~100 m NE of the lodge across the meadow; the RV sites are in the trees to the west.
